description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_PropertyList, which implements a property list data structure with support for inheritance, caching, and recursive retrieval. It provides methods to set, get, check, reset, and squash properties, and manage parent-child relationships between property lists.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_PropertyList
classes.description: Class implementing a recursive property list with inheritance, caching, and property management functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a property list, optionally with a parent list for inheritance.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Recursively retrieves the value for a given property name, searching in parent list if not found locally.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a property's value in the current list.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a property exists in the current list.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets a specific property or the entire list to default (empty).

methods.name: squash
methods.description: Combines current and parent property lists into a single array, with caching support.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent property list if any.
